name: cue
description: A calm, keyboard-first daily notes and to-do app.
author: Zach Waterfield
//: Each app installs and builds on its own (apps/desktop, apps/mobile). There are no dependencies here: these are shortcuts, so the commands in the README still work from the repository root.

scripts.install:all: pnpm -C apps/desktop install && pnpm -C apps/mobile install
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C apps/desktop typecheck && pnpm -C apps/mobile typecheck
